document:475.text:
It has been confirmed that third-year students Felin and Sancy attempted to cheat on the "History of Magic" exam using a miniature answer sheet. Halfway through the exam, the sheet was subject to an unidentified high-intensity amplification spell, suddenly expanding to the size of the blackboard and causing significant chaos when it collapsed onto the exam hall floor.
Cheating is strictly prohibited. To maintain disciplinary standards, both students have been disqualified from this exam and placed on academic probation.
Let this serve as a stern warning to all faculty and students to uphold the integrity and honor of our school.
document:475.source_cn:
经查明，正式班三年级学生菲林与珊丝，在《魔法历史》考试中，意图使用违禁的微缩卷轴携带答案进行作弊。然而，该卷轴在考场上受到一股未知来源的强效放大魔法影响，瞬间膨胀至教室黑板大小，并因其巨大体积砸落而导致考场秩序一度混乱。
此行为严重违背了学院的诚信原则，为严肃纪律，现决定取消二人本次考试资格，处以留校察看处分。
望全体师生引以为戒，恪守莱希拉姆学院的荣誉与准则。
